edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production. Defendant will serve amended, request-specific responses within seven days of the accompanying letter, identifying any specific objections and whether responsive materials are being withheld on each stated basis.

1. OBJECTIONS. Defendant does not assert a blanket privilege objection to every request. Any objection will be stated in the response to the particular request, with its basis and scope and a statement whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. Any privilege claim will identify the privilege or protection asserted without disclosing protected information.

2. PRODUCTION. Defendant proposes beginning rolling production of responsive, non-privileged documents within 14 days of the accompanying letter and completing production within 30 days. Defendant will identify any scope issues requiring a conference within seven days and proposes conferring within the following three business days. Scope disputes will not delay production of undisputed materials.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. No privilege log accompanied the prior response. Defendant proposes providing, within seven days of the accompanying letter, a log identifying materials then withheld on privilege or work-product grounds and providing sufficient information to assess each claim without disclosing protected information. Defendant will supplement the log as review proceeds and complete supplementation within the proposed 30-day production period.

4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement its responses and production as required by the applicable rules and any court order. This statement does not expand objections or alter applicable deadlines.

INTERNAL—PARTNER REVIEW: Before sending, confirm the proposed deadlines against existing orders and collection/review status; obtain the actual requests and prepare request-specific responses stating verified withholding positions. Locate and review any existing privilege log. Do not represent that a log is enclosed unless it is actually attached. Remove this internal comment from the outgoing document.
